name: verification-integration
goal: The branch preserves cold public API imports, canonical planning references and decoded design images while enforcing component evidence and task completion.

evidence: The broad committed run exposes a cold public API import of an undeclared Svelte compiler, planning references filtered by helper display rules, and design URLs revoked before their DOM image detaches. Existing tests demonstrate these failures.

Packed-consumer, project-run-references and image-url standardized coverage already owns these paths. Extend it with actual exported plan auditing, a canonical registry assertion and a DOM-safe release assertion; preserve browser error collection.
